title: Add deterministic provider registry
prompt: Continue Phase 10 by adding src/ade/provider_registry.py. Implement an immutable/provider-agnostic ProviderRegistry that registers ProviderDescriptor plus an already-constructed CodingAgentProvider instance, rejects duplicate provider IDs, exposes descriptors without secrets, and returns deterministic candidates filtered by enabled state and RoutingRequest requirements. The registry must never construct providers or read credentials. Add tests for duplicate IDs, disabled providers, required capabilities, allow-list filtering, preference order, deterministic fallback order, and no mutation. Export from ade.__init__. No dependencies.
